title: Haryana: Farmers kick off Hisar-Delhi march

ai.summary: Haryana farmers began a march toward Delhi demanding land for a memorial to honor 750 farmers who died during the 2020-21 agitation, with plans to hold a rally in Bahadurgarh on November 26.

facts.claim: Haryana farmers began a march toward Delhi
facts.quote: A group of farmers on Thursday began a march from Hisar towards Delhi

facts.claim: demanding land for a memorial to honor 750 farmers who died during the 2020-21 agitation
facts.quote: Farmers seek memorial for all 750 farmers who died during the 2020-21 stir

facts.claim: with plans to hold a rally in Bahadurgarh on November 26
facts.quote: They have announced a rally in Bahadurgarh on November 26 to mark the anniversary of the farmers’ agitation
